fact: On 23 June 2025 the Interior Ministry's secretary general said the government's ambition is to interconnect the biometric persons registry (RBPP), the national digital identity system (SNID) and the national civil registry centre (CNEC) around a common biometric reference, as workshops opened to draw up a roadmap.
title: Gabon Digital phase II : réflexion profonde des experts sur trois projets numériques
